title: The click-away timer encodes a mode ("a blur is pending") beside the saved-value editor's state
evidence: widget-src/src/lib/value-cell-state.ts: blurPending{wait: delay | press | release} is a state of the editor's one union, changed only by its pure transition; ValueCell (widget-src/src/components/MatrixSavedCells.tsx) arms its one timer as the machine enters a blurPending state and clears it as it leaves, so no exit can forget it. blurTimerRef, afterRelease, clearBlurTimer and runWaiting are gone. value-cell-state.test.ts walks every state x event; MatrixSavedCells.refocus.test.tsx (PR 1691) and MatrixSavedCells.page-hide.test.tsx pin the refocus and page-hide rules (US-04 AC1). Owner ruling R2, 2026-11-14: the page going away runs a pending click-away save in its 150 ms delay too, never text in an open editor.
